Supported printers

Handwriting on 404 3D printers

Handplot turns typed text into real-looking handwriting that your 3D printer writes with a pen in a pen holder, like a pen plotter. It makes plain G-code for every printer below: Bambu Lab, Prusa, Creality, Anycubic, Elegoo, Voron, Qidi, Sovol and 53 more makers. Each printer's writing area, keep-out areas and firmware come from OrcaSlicer's printer profiles; Bambu Lab's are checked by hand.

First time on a printer? Pick it in the app, run the offset test, then save a reach check (no pen, no paper) and a dry run before using ink. How to calibrate
